question.nlq: Hey! Could you help me find the three highest‑ranked stores that carry at least three scanners with a DPI over 500? I'd also love to know which district each of those stores belongs to.

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT s."Store_Name", d."District_name"
FROM "store" s
JOIN (
    SELECT sp."Store_ID"
    FROM "store_product" sp
    JOIN "product" p ON sp."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
    WHERE p."dpi" > 500
    GROUP BY sp."Store_ID"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sp."Product_ID") >= 3
) eligible ON s."Store_ID" = eligible."Store_ID"
JOIN "store_district" sd ON s."Store_ID" = sd."Store_ID"
JOIN "district" d ON sd."District_ID" = d."District_ID"
ORDER BY s."Ranking" ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH qualified_stores AS (
    SELECT sp.Store_ID
    FROM store_product sp
    JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
    WHERE p.dpi > 500
    GROUP BY sp.Store_ID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.Product_ID) >= 3
)
SELECT s.Store_Name, s.Ranking, d.District_name
FROM qualified_stores qs
JOIN store s ON qs.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
ORDER BY s.Ranking DESC
LIMIT 3;

question.nlq: Could you tell me which districts have a total store area greater than 150 and contain at least one store that offers a product with a pages_per_minute_color rate above 20?

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT d."District_name"
FROM "district" d
JOIN "store_district" sd ON d."District_ID" = sd."District_ID"
JOIN "store" s ON sd."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
GROUP BY d."District_ID"
HAVING SUM(s."Area_size") > 150
   AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM "store" s2
       JOIN "store_district" sd2 ON s2."Store_ID" = sd2."Store_ID"
       JOIN "store_product" sp2 ON s2."Store_ID" = sp2."Store_ID"
       JOIN "product" p2 ON sp2."Product_ID" = p2."Product_ID"
       WHERE sd2."District_ID" = d."District_ID"
         AND p2."pages_per_minute_color" > 20
   );

HAVING SUM(s.Area_size) > 150

question.nlq: Please identify the top three stores situated in each district, ranked according to the average dots per inch specification of the products carried by each store.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH store_avg_dpi AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.District_ID,
        d.District_name,
        s.Store_Name,
        AVG(p.dpi) AS avg_dpi
    FROM product p
    JOIN store_product sp ON p.product_id = sp.Product_ID
    JOIN store s ON sp.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
    JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
    GROUP BY sd.District_ID, d.District_name, s.Store_Name
),
ranked_stores AS (
    SELECT 
        District_ID,
        District_name,
        Store_Name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY District_ID ORDER BY avg_dpi DESC) AS rn
    FROM store_avg_dpi
)
SELECT District_name, Store_Name
FROM ranked_stores
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY District_ID, rn;

turns.sql:
WITH store_avg AS (
    SELECT s.Store_ID, s.Store_Name, AVG(p.dpi) AS avg_dpi
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_product sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
    JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
    GROUP BY s.Store_ID, s.Store_Name
),
store_dist AS (
    SELECT sa.Store_ID, sa.Store_Name, sa.avg_dpi, sd.District_ID, d.District_name
    FROM store_avg sa
    JOIN store_district sd ON sa.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT District_name, Store_Name, avg_dpi,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY District_ID ORDER BY avg_dpi DESC) AS rn
    FROM store_dist
)
SELECT District_name, Store_Name, avg_dpi, rn AS rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY District_name, rn;

WITH store_avg AS (
  SELECT s.Store_ID, s.Store_Name, AVG(p.dpi) AS avg_dpi
  FROM store s
  JOIN store_product sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
  JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
  GROUP BY s.Store_ID, s.Store_Name
),
store_dist AS (
  SELECT sa.Store_ID, sa.Store_Name, sa.avg_dpi, d.District_ID, d.District_name
  FROM store_avg sa
  JOIN store_district sd ON sa.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
  JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
)
SELECT District_name, Store_Name, avg_dpi
FROM (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY District_ID ORDER BY avg_dpi DESC) AS rn
  FROM store_dist
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY District_name, avg_dpi DESC;

WITH store_avg_dpi AS (
    SELECT sp.store_id, AVG(p.dpi) AS avg_dpi
    FROM store_product sp
    JOIN product p ON sp.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY sp.store_id
),
store_district_join AS (
    SELECT s.store_id,
           s.store_name,
           d.district_id,
           d.district_name,
           sad.avg_dpi
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_district sd ON s.store_id = sd.store_id
    JOIN district d ON sd.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN store_avg_dpi sad ON s.store_id = sad.store_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY avg_dpi DESC, store_id) AS rn
    FROM store_district_join
)
SELECT store_id,
       store_name,
       district_name,
       avg_dpi
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY district_id, rn;

WITH store_avg AS (
    SELECT sp.Store_ID, AVG(p.dpi) AS avg_dpi
    FROM store_product sp
    JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
    GROUP BY sp.Store_ID
)
SELECT Store_Name, District_name, avg_dpi, rn AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT s.Store_Name, d.District_name, sa.avg_dpi,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.District_ID ORDER BY sa.avg_dpi DESC) AS rn
    FROM store_avg sa
    JOIN store s ON s.Store_ID = sa.Store_ID
    JOIN store_district sd ON sd.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
    JOIN district d ON d.District_ID = sd.District_ID
) WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY District_name, rn;

WITH store_avg_dpi AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.District_ID,
        sp.Store_ID,
        AVG(p.dpi) as avg_dpi
    FROM store_district sd
    JOIN store_product sp ON sd.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
    JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
    GROUP BY sd.District_ID, sp.Store_ID
)
SELECT 
    s.Store_Name,
    d.District_name,
    sad.avg_dpi,
    d.District_ID
FROM store s
JOIN store_avg_dpi sad ON s.Store_ID = sad.Store_ID
JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID AND sad.District_ID = sd.District_ID
JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
WHERE (
    sad.District_ID, sad.avg_dpi
) IN (
    SELECT District_ID, avg_dpi
    FROM store_avg_dpi sad2
    WHERE sad2.District_ID = sad.District_ID
    ORDER BY avg_dpi DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
ORDER BY d.District_ID, sad.avg_dpi DESC;

WITH store_avg_dpi AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.Store_ID,
        sd.District_ID,
        AVG(p.dpi) as avg_dpi
    FROM store_district sd
    JOIN store_product sp ON sd.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
    JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
    GROUP BY sd.Store_ID, sd.District_ID
),
ranked_stores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.Store_Name,
        d.District_name,
        sad.avg_dpi,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sad.District_ID ORDER BY sad.avg_dpi DESC) as rank
    FROM store_avg_dpi sad
    JOIN store s ON sad.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
    JOIN district d ON sad.District_ID = d.District_ID
)
SELECT Store_Name, District_name, avg_dpi
